summary: Verified new AzuraCast Auto-Fill feature in Broadcast Center. Positive path fully working: pasting https://demo.azuracast.com/api/nowplaying/azuratest_radio and clicking Auto-fill populates Host=demo.azuracast.com, Public stream URL contains /listen/azuratest_radio/ (radio.mp3), Status URL matches nowplaying URL, Name=AzuraTest Radio; success message references the station name. Negative path shows friendly inline error ('Couldn't find the station code in that URL...') without crashing. Broadcast Center continues to render normally after the operation and the station values persist in edit-in-place (no explicit save button — auto-persisted via updateStation onChange).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (bitrate <select> options wrap value in a dynamic <span>). Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: (Optional) Clean up bitrate <option> children to avoid nested <span> causing React hydration warning in StationsModal.js line ~366.
critical_code_review_comments: StationsModal.js is large — consider splitting StationCard into its own file.
autoFillAzura relies on network call with no timeout/AbortController; if the resolve endpoint hangs, the 'resolving' state may stick. Consider adding a fetch timeout.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage hotlive95_license before load and dismissed the PWA Install prompt via 'Maybe later'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AzuraCast Auto-Fill flow works end-to-end in the Broadcast Center. If retesting, remember to dismiss the 'Install Hot Live 95' modal (click 'Maybe later') before interacting with the header Go Live button, otherwise the modal overlay intercepts clicks. Station edits are auto-persisted (no explicit save button per station).
